campus_notes: Covers all four New Brunswick residential campuses (College Avenue, Busch, Cook/Douglass, Livingston; 51 buildings) from ruoncampus.rutgers.edu. Rutgers publishes a single hall-wide 'Average Room Size' per building rather than per-room-type dimensions; that figure is recorded on the hall's standard double (or suite/apartment bedroom) and singles are left null per honest-data rules. Published sizes normalized so length is the longer side. Beds are Twin XL except Sojourner Truth Apartments (full-size). Traditional halls have communal bathrooms; suites and apartments have private bathrooms.
